decision.summary: A confirmed temporary offset occurs 529–532 with coherent multi-axis transient (N↓, E↓then↑, U↑then↓). A second candidate interval 545–555 shows correlated N/U step-down without clear return; status uncertain. Optional jump at 539 aligns with interior of first event but does not define its boundaries; jump at 553 appears to be a partial rebound but lacks full recovery on N/U, supporting uncertainty.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply from ~+2 to ~−8 MAD over 3–4 samples (529–532), E dips ~−3 MAD (529–531) then rebounds, U spikes to +18 MAD at 530 then collapses by 532; all axes show coherent multi-sample transient with clear onset (≈529) and return by 532. Confirmed temporary offset.

N and U step down together around 545–547 (N: −6→−12 MAD; U: +5→−1 MAD), while E remains flat; no clear opposing return observed within allowed context (ends at 699, but post-555 behavior shows only noisy fluctuations without recovery to pre-step levels). Return ambiguous; status uncertain.
